meta.title: 分镜脚本｜人物出场设计

scenes.context: 人物出场是分镜设计的关键环节，出场的头几秒决定了观众对人物的一切预判。
sentences: 人物出场是分镜设计中最关键的环节之一。
A character's entrance is one of the most crucial parts of storyboard design.
character entrance（人物出场）
出场方式决定了观众对人物的第一印象和情绪期待。
The entrance shapes the audience's first impression and emotional expectations.
first impression（第一印象）
人物出场的头几秒，观众已经在潜意识中完成对这个人物的定位。
Within the first seconds, viewers subconsciously decide who this character is.
subconscious judgment（潜意识定位）
这些判断不是来自台词，而是来自出场镜头的角度、运动、光线、景别。
These judgments come not from dialogue but from the angle, motion, light, and shot size.
angle and shot size（角度与景别）
scenes.speak: A character's entrance is one of the most crucial parts of storyboard design. The entrance shapes the audience's first impression and emotional expectations. Within the first seconds, viewers subconsciously decide who this character is. These judgments come not from dialogue but from the angle, motion, light, and shot size.

scenes.context: 低角度仰拍显高大，背影转正面造悬念，眼睛特写层层揭示，环境铺垫自然浮现，标志性动作直接立人设。
sentences: 从下往上拍，人物显得高大、强势、威严。
Shooting from below makes the character look tall, powerful, and imposing.
low-angle shot（低角度拍摄）
先拍背影，再转正面，制造悬念和期待。
Show the back first, then reveal the face—creating suspense and anticipation.
suspense（悬念）
眼睛特写，再给全貌，层层揭示。
Close-up on the eyes, then the full view, revealing layer by layer.
layer by layer（层层揭示）
先拍环境，人物从环境中浮现，融入叙事。
Establish the setting first, letting the character emerge from it into the story.
emerge from the scene（从环境中浮现）
让人物在做标志性动作时出场，直接建立性格。
Introduce the character mid-signature-action to establish personality instantly.
signature action（标志性动作）
scenes.speak: Shooting from below makes the character look tall, powerful, and imposing. Show the back first, then reveal the face—creating suspense and anticipation. Close-up on the eyes, then the full view, revealing layer by layer. Establish the setting first, letting the character emerge from it into the story. Introduce the character mid-signature-action to establish personality instantly.

scenes.context: 所有人物的出场方式都一样会失去区分度；俯拍显弱小、平拍不够压迫。
sentences: 常见误区：所有人物的出场方式都一样，没有区分度。
Common mistake: every character enters the same way, with no distinction.
no distinction（没有区分度）
让一个角色从暗处走出来和从亮处走出来，感受截然不同。
A character emerging from darkness feels completely different from one in light.
dark vs light（暗处与亮处）
不要在主角出场时用俯拍，会显得弱小。
Don't use a high angle for a protagonist—it makes them look weak.
avoid high angle（慎用俯拍）
不要在反派出场时用平拍，不够压迫感。
Don't shoot a villain at eye level—it lacks menace.
lack of menace（不够压迫）
背影时间不要太长，观众会等得不耐烦，应尽快转正面。
Don't linger on the back too long—turn to the face before viewers get bored.
don't linger（不要太久）
scenes.speak: Common mistake: every character enters the same way, with no distinction. A character emerging from darkness feels completely different from one in light. Don't use a high angle for a protagonist—it makes them look weak. Don't shoot a villain at eye level—it lacks menace. Don't linger on the back too long—turn to the face before viewers get bored.

scenes.context: 主角用仰拍、配角用平拍，用镜头角度建立人物之间的视觉层级。
sentences: 主角用仰拍、配角用平拍，利用镜头角度建立视觉层级。
Protagonists shot low, supporting roles at eye level—angles create a visual hierarchy.
visual hierarchy（视觉层级）
选择出场方式前，先确定人物的关键词。
Before picking an entrance, define the character's keywords.
character keywords（人物关键词）
练习局部出场：先拍手部特写，再拉远露出人物全貌。
Practice partial entrances: a hand close-up, then pull back to reveal the full person.
partial entrance（局部出场）
尝试用环境出场，代替直接对着镜头说大家好。
Try scene-based entrances instead of saying hi directly to the camera.
scene-based entrance（环境出场）
设计人物的第一个镜头，就是在叙事。
Designing a character's first shot is storytelling in itself.
the first shot is storytelling（第一个镜头即叙事）
scenes.speak: Protagonists shot low, supporting roles at eye level—angles create a visual hierarchy. Before picking an entrance, define the character's keywords. Practice partial entrances: a hand close-up, then pull back to reveal the full person. Try scene-based entrances instead of saying hi directly to the camera. Designing a character's first shot is storytelling in itself.

scenes.context: 适合叙事类视频、短片、人物介绍；教程类和多人物群像需要不同设计。
sentences: 出场方式要和整体视频风格一致，不需要过于戏剧化。
The entrance should match the overall video style—no need to over-dramatize.
match the style（风格一致）
适合叙事类视频、短片、人物介绍。
It fits narrative videos, short films, and character introductions.
narrative videos（叙事类视频）
不需要区分人物的纯教程类视频，则不必过度设计。
Pure tutorial videos that don't distinguish characters need less design.
tutorials need less（教程类从简）
scenes.speak: The entrance should match the overall video style—no need to over-dramatize. It fits narrative videos, short films, and character introductions. Pure tutorial videos that don't distinguish characters need less design.

practice: The first seconds decide who the character is.
Low angle, back reveal, eye close-up, scene emergence, signature action.
Protagonists shot low, supporting roles at eye level.
Don't use high angle on heroes or eye level on villains.
Let the character emerge from the scene, not say hi to the camera.
pitfalls: Let every character enter the same way.
Backs, eyes, and scenes build suspense.
High angles make protagonists look weak.
Linger on the back too long.
Turn to the face before viewers get bored.
Pick an entrance without character keywords.
Define keywords first, then match the entrance.
shifts: 用 character positioning（人物定位）、first impression（第一印象）、visual hierarchy（视觉层级）
用 narrative tool（叙事工具）、environment entrance（环境出场）、signature action（标志性动作）
用 layer-by-layer reveal（层层揭示）、mystery（神秘感）、back-to-face（背影转正面）
